LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. By the end of the Sub

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. By the end of the Sub
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to by the end of the Sub. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives.
2. Explain Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: collaboratively talk about various items in the classroom using adjectives,
4. Show that you can: By the end of the Sub
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Collaboratively talk about various items in the classroom using adjectives,
2. Describe items using the comparative forms of regular and irregular adjectives with peers,
3. Write correct sentences using comparative forms of adjectives in the right order,
4. Write sentences on tablets, computers and other digital resources using adjectives,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. By the end of the Sub

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
